# SYNESIS_E057 — Error

## Description

`ITEM FIELDS` block declared more than once in the template.

## Severity

An **error** stops compilation: no JSON, CSV or other export is written until it is fixed. Errors local to an `EXPORT` block are reported as warnings when compiling and stop only that block in `synesis export`.

## Compiler message

```text
The template has more than one `ITEM FIELDS` block. Only one block
  of this kind is allowed per template — two would make it ambiguous
  which fields are valid in the blocks.
  Merge all declarations into a single `ITEM FIELDS` block.
```

## Where it appears

Values the diagnostic carries (what the message names):

- **DuplicateScopeBlock**: `scope`
